contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (33,786.18) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (33,786.18) AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report' (33,786.18)
contributions.detail: The 9 Schedule A rows on p2 sum to 103.83 + 200.00 + 207.35 + 2000.00 + 5000.00 + 15000.00 + 250.00 + 10000.00 + 1025.00 = 33,786.18 exactly, equal to all three printed figures; the page-subtotal gate and the sum-of-all-pages gate coincide because Schedule A is a single sheet. TWO SELF-LOANS ARE INSIDE THE ANCHOR: the rows named 'David Leavitt-Loan' (10,000.00 on 7/7/2022 and 1,025.00 on 7/13/2022) are written on the contributions ledger and the filer's own subtotal includes them — running the ladder (ADDENDUM B3) therefore makes them ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION ROWS, not beginning-balance items; without them the side would fall 11,025.00 short of both the printed subtotal and Box B. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 435,619.54 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (165,189.35) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (165,189.35) AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B Pages in this report' (165,189.35)
expenditures.detail: The 7 Schedule B rows on p3 sum to 47926.62 + 20000.00 + 18134.17 + 17401.00 + 56623.40 + 5000.00 + 104.16 = 165,189.35 exactly, equal to all three printed figures. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints 435,480.39 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed. The summary ladder is internally consistent: Box F 165,432.94 = Box A 131,646.76 + Box B 33,786.18, and Box G 243.59 = Box F − Box D 165,189.35.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only, and BOTH sides close on it exactly (33,786.18 and 165,189.35). BOTH conventions were tested and are IDENTICAL because no in-kind is claimed on this filing: the newer unversioned 2022 blank carries an 'In-Kind' checkbox column on both schedules, and per ADDENDUM J1 the Amount and In-Kind cells were cropped TOGETHER as one full-column block per schedule page, so the pairing is read from a single image rather than by vertical position. All 9 contribution checkboxes and all 7 expenditure checkboxes render EMPTY beside their own amounts, as do the boxes on the unused rows.
itemized.escalation_note: (1) the whole Amount + In-Kind column of Schedule A at 900 dpi, rendering all 9 rows in band order plus the 6 empty rows below them. (2) the same for Schedule B, rendering all 7 rows plus the 8 empty rows below them. Both are recorded figure-by-figure in the frames' measure_notes. Nothing was in doubt — this is a typed fillable PDF, crisply scanned — and no figure was changed.

itemized.notes:
PAGE-FACE NAME IS 'David O Leavitt' where index.csv's channel label is 'David Leavitt' — the page face governs and the divergence is recorded rather than resolved. Page-face office 'Utah County Attorney' agrees with index.csv's 'County Attorney'. Report type '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' (index.csv's reporting_period is 'Out in Primary', a channel paraphrase of the same thing), signed in ink with Date and Date of Filing both 8/1/2022, amendment 'No' ticked.

FORM: modern_boxAF on the NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 blank — no version string, Schedule A headed 'City and State' with a fifth 'In-Kind' checkbox column, close box LETTERED 'G', SIX report types including End-of-Year, a 'Date of Filing' box, no Page field anywhere so the filing is UNFOLIATED. Typed fillable PDF, crisply scanned.

FOUR PAGES, ALL FOUR REPORT SHEETS: p1 cover / p2 Schedule A / p3 Schedule B / p4 SUMMARY PAGE. Every page classified from its own printed header. NO CHECKLIST and no blank verso.

THIS IS THE COMPANION TO 94690c69 — the same candidate's next report, and the two are a matched pair worth reading together: 94690c69 is his pre-Primary report (6/20/2022) and this is his post-elimination report (8/1/2022). Between them he raised 331,334.58 and spent 357,449.92 in the 2022 cycle's Primary phase alone.

TWO SELF-LOANS ON THE CONTRIBUTIONS LEDGER, resolved by the ladder and not by the word (ADDENDUM B3): 'David Leavitt-Loan' 10,000.00 and 1,025.00 ARE itemized contribution rows, because the filer's own page subtotal — which equals Box B exactly — includes them. His previous filing resolved a THIRD loan the same way ('Wasatch Acquisitions (Loan)' 100,000.00). Three loans, three times the ladder decided, never the wording.

THE 'CITY AND STATE' COLUMN IS BLANK ON ALL 9 CONTRIBUTION ROWS, and there is not a single redaction bar on this filing — the county published it UNREDACTED, and the candidate's own home address is printed in the clear on the cover (deliberately NOT carried into this record, not into a field and not into a note). So the blank address column is the FILER'S OMISSION, a different fact from the county's redaction on the Cox filings in this same chunk and cycle.

A DATE CELL HOLDING A RANGE, for the second time from this filer: Schedule B line 7 is dated '6/20-7/22' with no year. Kept verbatim with needs_review=1.

CROSS-FILING CONTINUITY, RECORDED AS OBSERVATION ONLY AND NOT USED AS A GATE (no two covers were differenced): Box A 131,646.76 equals the closing Box G of his 6/20/2022 filing; Box C 435,619.54 = that filing's 401,833.36 + this filing's 33,786.18; Box E 435,480.39 = its 270,291.04 + this filing's 165,189.35. All three identities hold to the cent, which is a property of the documents worth recording — but every reconciliation above was gated on THIS filing's own printed figures.

AMOUNT PUNCTUATION FLIPS BETWEEN THIS FILER'S OWN TWO FILINGS: the June report types thousands commas ('2,000.00'), this one does not ('2000.00'). Both are carried as plain decimal strings with no digit altered.
